facultyPage.intro: The people who teach at Vidyansh, and what each of them is responsible for. Profiles are published only once each teacher has written and approved their own.

bio: This is where Shubham Sir's own account of how he came to teach will sit: where he studied, what he prepared for himself, and the moment he decided that preparing others was the work he wanted to do.
A second paragraph on how he teaches in a room. How a class begins, how long he stays on one idea, and why he will slow a lecture down rather than leave one student behind.
A third paragraph on Vidyansh itself: why he founded it, what he asks of the teachers who join him, and what he wants a student to feel on the day their result comes.
Years of teaching, subjects and any other facts will be added here only once he has supplied and confirmed them.

teachingStatements.statement: We teach the idea before the trick.
teachingStatements.body: A shortcut you understand is a method. A shortcut you memorised is a guess.

teachingStatements.statement: Every question is chosen on purpose.
teachingStatements.body: Practice is set to teach something specific, never to fill a page.

teachingStatements.statement: A doubt is answered by a teacher.
teachingStatements.body: Not a bot, not a forum. Someone who knows the subject and knows you.

teachingStatements.statement: The plan is written down, week by week.
teachingStatements.body: So a student always knows what today is for.
